# Clawless Computer

> Clawless Computer is a desktop app for running AI agents on your own Mac with your own keys. It is a desktop home for OpenClaw, the open source AI agent engine. Coming soon. It will be free and open source under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 (AGPL-3.0), with the source published on GitHub at launch. A product of RBJ Global LLC.

## Status

- Coming soon. Not yet released.
- At launch the source code and the signed download for macOS are published together on GitHub.
- Until then there is no download, and the source repository is not public.

## What it does

- Chat with any major provider: pick a model, stream replies, stop mid-answer, keep full history, using your own keys for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq and more
- A team of agents: seven default agents, plus agents you create and edit yourself
- Memory across four tiers; automatic saving is off until you turn it on, and untouched memories age into a Decayed tier instead of being deleted
- Tools and MCP servers, with control over which tools each agent may use
- Skills from the ClawHub catalog, with optional VirusTotal checks before install
- Channels: reach your agents from Telegram, Discord, Slack and other messaging platforms
- Scheduled automations: cron jobs and recurring prompts
- Browser automation: an agent can open a real browser, navigate, click, type, read pages and take screenshots
- Attachments (screenshots, PDFs, Word documents, Markdown) and image generation in the chat
- A usage dashboard and CostGuard monthly spending caps
- App lock with a PIN and a recovery code

## How it works

- Runs on macOS on Apple silicon
- Bring your own keys: messages go from your Mac to the AI provider you choose, using your own key
- No account: no email, no sign-up, no card
- No telemetry in the app: engine telemetry is turned off and there is no crash reporting
- OpenClaw is a separate open source project under the MIT license

## Family

Clawless Computer is one of several products from RBJ Global LLC. The full list is at https://clawless.ai/family/

- [RBJ Global](https://rbjglobal.com/): parent company
- [Clawdemy](https://clawdemy.org/): free AI literacy, the math and ML behind your AI tools
- [Trading Agents Lab](https://tradingagentslab.ai/): open source multi-agent trading research
- [ClaudeLink](https://claudelink.ai/): coordinate a team of AI coding agents
- [Clawddesk](https://clawddesk.ai/): a personal agent command desk
- [WhisprDesk](https://whisprdesk.com/): local speech-to-text for Mac
- [iLoveMD](https://iluvmd.com/): document conversion that never uploads
